STUFF((SELECT ', ' + cm.code_name FROM tb_car_ac_group g JOIN tb_common cm ON cm.cmm_id = 'CAR' AND cm.code_id = g.code_id WHERE g.car_id = c.car_id ORDER BY cm.code_id FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS ac_code_names FROM tb_car c LEFT JOIN tb_common ct ON ct.cmm_id = 'CT' AND ct.code_id = c.car_type LEFT JOIN tb_company co ON co.company_code = c.company_code LEFT JOIN tb_person p ON p.person_id = c.car_manager_id WHERE c.del_yn = 'N' AND c.company_code = #{companyCode} ORDER BY c.car_id DESC
